paper_title: Quantitative Universal Approximation for Noisy Quantum Neural Networks
human_review_reasons: training_pipeline confidence (0.45) is below 0.5 - optimizer hyperparameters (learning rate, iteration counts, convergence criteria) are not specified in the paper for any of Methods A/B/C

implementation_assumptions confidence (0.45) is below 0.5 - several assumptions (n0 value, loss normalisation constant, readout error probability p) required to make the paper fully reproducible are not explicitly stated

Stage 3 risk_assessment flags two High-severity risks carried from the SIR: unspecified optimizer hyperparameters, and a readout-error probability p used in the reported hardware bound but absent from the paper's own hardware parameter table

Stage 4: all High/Medium-severity risk items are implemented as explicitly ASSUMED, config-overridable values (configs/config.yaml comments) rather than silent hardcoded constants; recommend human verification before treating generated repo output as a faithful reproduction

Stage 6: reproducibility_score=0.0 on ArXivist's own self-check comparison (no external user results were available). Root causes identified: (1) Gaussian-density experiment used the wrong optimizer relative to the paper (L-BFGS-B instead of the paper's stated differential evolution, Section 4.2) -- QNNTrainer does not implement differential evolution at all (omission hallucination); (2) computed hardware fidelity factor alpha=0.99 vs. paper's reported 0.365 (171% deviation), traced to the paper's own approximate two-qubit gate-count formula producing an implausibly low gate count (critical parametric hallucination). See comparison/hallucination_report.md and comparison/benchmark_comparison.md for full detail and suggested fixes.
